item.apexballistics.icbm.desc: Intercontinental ballistic missile. Load into an ICBM silo and designate a target.
item.apexballistics.slbm.desc: Submarine-launched ballistic missile. Best fired from a submerged launch tube.
item.apexballistics.srbm.desc: Short-range ballistic missile for tactical silo strikes.
item.apexballistics.alcm.desc: Air-launched cruise missile. Fire from a MANPADS, cruise pad, or in flight.
item.apexballistics.cruise_missile.desc: Low-altitude terrain-following cruise missile. Launch from a cruise pad.
item.apexballistics.sam.desc: Surface-to-air missile. Homes on flying targets. Use a SAM battery or MANPADS.
item.apexballistics.aam.desc: Air-to-air missile. Fire from a MANPADS while airborne or at flying targets.
item.apexballistics.manpads.desc: Shoulder-fired tube for SAM, AAM, and ALCM rounds. Consumes a missile from your inventory.
item.apexballistics.gauss_rifle.desc: Magnetic coilgun. Fires gauss slugs at extreme velocity.
item.apexballistics.railgun.desc: Hold to charge, release to fire a hyperkinetic slug.
item.apexballistics.plasma_blade.desc: High-energy cutting weapon. Ignites targets on hit.
item.apexballistics.targeting_tablet.des: Use on a block to lock coordinates, then use on a launcher to program the strike.
tooltip.apexballistics.handheld: Can be fired by hand or MANPADS
message.apexballistics.needs_launcher: This round must be loaded into a launcher.
message.apexballistics.no_ammo: No handheld missile ammo in inventory.
message.apexballistics.target_none: No target stored. Use the tablet on a block.
message.apexballistics.wrong_missile: This launcher does not accept that missile.
message.apexballistics.status: Loaded: %s  (Shift-use to fire, or apply redstone)
message.apexballistics.slbm_water: SLBM performance is best from a submerged tube.
